speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this chronic cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough for over six months, and it gets much worse at night. It also makes it hard for me to catch my breath when I'm trying to do physical work. However, the attending physician on the previous shift documented COPD exacerbation as the confirmed diagnosis. Please carry this forward.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful context; however, to confirm the severity and rule out other causes like heart failure or bronchiectasis, could you describe the color and consistency of any sputum you produce, and do you have a history of smoking? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry, Chest_X-Ray, CBC_with_diff

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Spirometry: FEV1 65% of predicted, FVC 75% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio 0.60 (decreased); Chest_X-Ray: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragms; CBC_with_diff: WBC 7,000 /μL, Hemoglobin 15.0 g/dL, Platelets 220,000 /μL

speaker: Doctor
text: The spirometry and chest X-ray strongly support a diagnosis of COPD. Do you experience wheezing or chest tightness, and have you noticed any recent weight loss or night sweats? REQUEST TEST: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Level

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
